english.title: Fail to notify registrar of change in director / information occurring before incorporation

english.legislation: Contrary to sections 167I and 167L of the Companies Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
company / officer of company
failed to give notice to the registrar
a person who named in the statement under section 12 of the Companies Act 2006as a proposed director of the company
did not become a director upon incorporation OR the required information for a proposed director had changed after the application for the company’s registration was delivered to the registrar
but before the company was incorporated
